title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Issuing the Implementation Opinions on the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate Attending Meetings of the Judicial Committee of the People's Court
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate

Notice on Issuing the Implementation Opinions on the Procurator-General's Attendance at the Judicial Committee Meeting of the People's Court

Fa Fa [2010] No. 4

To all local people's courts and people's procuratorates at all levels, military courts and procuratorates, intermediate and basic people's courts and procuratorates of railway transport, maritime courts and procuratorates, and courts and procuratorates at all levels in Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

Implementing and improving the provisions on the attendance of the Procurator-General or the Deputy Procurator-General authorized by the Procurator-General at the Judicial Committee meeting of the People's Court is one of the reform tasks stipulated in Document No. 28 [2008] of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee. On the basis of in-depth research, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate have formulated the Implementation Opinions on the Procurator-General's Attendance at the Judicial Committee Meeting of the People's Court, which were adopted at the 1475th Session of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on October 12, 2009, and at the 17th Session of the 11th Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on August 11, 2009. These Opinions are hereby issued and shall come into effect as of April 1, 2010. Please carry out the implementation in light of local actual conditions. If any issues arise during implementation, please report to the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate respectively.

January 12, 2010

Implementation Opinions on the Procurator-General's Attendance at the Judicial Committee Meeting of the People's Court

In order to further implement and regulate the system of the Procurator-General's attendance at the Judicial Committee meeting of the People's Court, and in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the PRC and other laws, the following opinions are put forward:

1. The Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate may attend the Judicial Committee meeting of the People's Court at the same level.

Where the Procurator-General is unable to attend, a Deputy Procurator-General may be authorized to attend the Judicial Committee meeting of the People's Court at the same level.

2. The task of the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate in attending the Judicial Committee meeting of the People's Court is to express opinions on the cases and other related topics discussed by the Judicial Committee, and to exercise the function of legal supervision in accordance with law.

3. Where the Judicial Committee of the People's Court discusses the following cases or topics, the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate at the same level may attend:

(1) Public prosecution cases in which the defendant may be found not guilty;

(2) Cases in which the defendant may be sentenced to death;

(3) Cases in which the People's Procuratorate has filed a protest;

(4) Other topics related to procuratorial work.

4. Where the President of the People's Court decides to submit a case or topic listed in Article 3 of these Opinions to the Judicial Committee for discussion, the People's Court shall notify the People's Procuratorate at the same level through appropriate means. Where the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate decides to attend the Judicial Committee meeting, the People's Court shall notify the People's Procuratorate of the meeting agenda and meeting time.

Where the People's Procuratorate deems it necessary with respect to a topic discussed by the Judicial Committee of the People's Court, it may request to attend the Judicial Committee meeting; where the People's Court deems it necessary, it may invite the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate to attend the Judicial Committee meeting.

5. Where the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate attends the Judicial Committee meeting, the People's Court shall deliver the meeting materials to the Procurator-General at the same time as delivering them to the members of the Judicial Committee.

6. Where the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate attends the Judicial Committee meeting, he or she shall make full preparations before the meeting and may, when necessary, convene a meeting of the Procuratorial Committee to discuss relevant issues.

7. The Procurator-General or the Deputy Procurator-General authorized by the Procurator-General, when attending the Judicial Committee meeting to discuss a case, may express opinions after the judge handling the case has finished reporting and before the members of the Judicial Committee vote.

Where the Judicial Committee meeting discusses other topics related to procuratorial work, the procedure for the speech of the Procurator-General or the Deputy Procurator-General authorized by the Procurator-General shall be governed by the preceding paragraph.

The opinions expressed by the Procurator-General or the Deputy Procurator-General authorized by the Procurator-General at the Judicial Committee meeting shall be recorded in the minutes.

8. Where the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate attends the Judicial Committee meeting to discuss a case, the People's Court shall serve or send a copy of the judicial document to the People's Procuratorate in a timely manner.

Where the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate attends the Judicial Committee meeting to discuss other topics, the People's Court shall deliver the text of the decision adopted to the People's Procuratorate in a timely manner.

9. All persons attending or sitting in on the Judicial Committee meeting shall keep confidential the contents of the discussion.

10. The specific matters concerning the attendance of the Procurator-General of the People's Procuratorate at the Judicial Committee meeting shall be handled by the administrative office of the Judicial Committee and the administrative office of the Procuratorial Committee.
